findings.text: the reading rule labels any pair in which both revisions lose the saddle and every captured boundary has finite moments as census-read, without testing whether the census misread a still-good state. The physical receipt shows the opposite observable: all three seeds carry a saddle 0.0120311 m from reference and a 1.44569 m2 enclosing contour; the exact seed has 83 core cells, 38,009.95 A unscaled support current and lambda 0.9818, while trip 1 has 5 cells / 605.51 A / lambda 61.63 before the capacity repair and 24 cells / 6,072.66 A / lambda 6.15 after it; chord falls from 61 core cells to 4 and 3,113.28 A with lambda 11.99. The trip-1 panels show the shared-level field collapsing into a band and the own-level field closing only as small outboard and wall-adjacent islands. Thus the receipt supports 'the first active-set step returns a collapsed state' and refutes the specific non-finite captured-support signature, but it does not support census-read as the causal mechanism; the step, wall cut-cell attribution and the census feeding the step remain unresolved.

support finiteness is recomputed after solve completion on the seed and returned trip-boundary states. It is not observed while the first Newton-Krylov active-set update is being formed, and it does not cover rejected inner trials; the receipt itself states that limit. Consequently zero non-finite moments at the collapsed returned state cannot exclude a transient support/attribution failure inside the step that created it, so line 46 promotes an exclusion the instrument did not measure into a mechanism verdict.

the plasma-shape guard is satisfied by any census-qualified O-point enclosed by any in-vessel contour, with no minimum enclosing area, domain-size, core-cell, support-current or relation-to-reference criterion. That makes the guard circular with the topology census under review and accepts the visibly degenerate outboard islands: the maximum enclosing area contracts from 1.44569 m2 in the seed to about 0.387-0.397 m2 at trip 1, core membership collapses to 5, 24 and 4 cells, and the own-level panels show multiple small wall islands, yet is_plasma remains true and the validator merely reasserts the same definition. The recorded 'first non-plasma state: never' and 'no invariant violation' therefore do not rebut the collapsed-state reading; the plan comment correctly calls for a domain-size or support-current criterion.

the run's conversational final is the pre-resume NEEDS-HELP record claiming zero measured arms and no physical verdict, while the later durable manifest is complete at 03fa0d1a8 with three measured arms. The manifest is the authoritative delivery and is internally complete, so this does not erase the measurement, but the terminal run directory contains two contradictory summaries without an explicit supersession marker; readers who open final.txt before manifest.md receive the obsolete blocked outcome.

Deductions: the validator lives beside the evidence rather than in a collected test lane, it independently recomputes only the same finite/finite equals census-read rule, it has no negative control for a collapsed finite state, and final.txt still presents the superseded blocked attempt.
justifications.evidence: the review reran the committed receipt validator at final tip and read the receipt rather than accepting the absence of an error. Positive controls establish that non-finite counting can see an injected NaN, the callback executes on H200, the analytic field has a closed plasma, and a ramp does not. The receipt quantitatively shows the seed-to-trip-1 transition: exact core cells 83 to 5 or 24, chord 61 to 4; unscaled support current 38.0 kA to 0.606, 6.073 or 3.113 kA; lambda 0.982 to 61.63, 6.15 or 11.99; maximum enclosing area 1.446 m2 to about 0.39 m2; and saddle loss on trip 1 in every arm. The deduction is central: the causal label is derived from a two-condition classifier and post-step recomputation, not an instrument that observes the mechanism during the failing step.
justifications.fit: the benchmark uses the public typed production construction, one H200 job, the root environment, native trip boundaries, committed nova.media-style line-contour panels with wall and both null sets, and mechanism-named source symbols without plan identifiers. The main deduction is semantic fit: census-read names a causal interpretation the instrument cannot distinguish, while the much stronger delivered result is a first-step collapse. The 425,426-line artifact delta is scientifically inspectable but unusually large because every contour path and searched level is serialized for every state.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node delivers the requested trajectories, controls, panels, static/dynamic lambda trace and trip-of-loss measurements, and it preserves all failures rather than filtering them. It misses the goal's deciding sentence: finite moments in both revised arms do not prove the census misread a valid state, and the panels instead show that the first returned active-set state is already collapsed. The correct disposition is therefore measured collapse with mechanism still open, exactly as live plan comment c-20260923-trip-panels-read states.
justifications.scope_discipline: the candidate worktree is clean; every one of the 97 changed paths falls under an exclusive declared prefix; no shared index, sprint resource or unrelated source is touched; the scratch revision trees were removed; all commits carry bodies and the inspected messages contain no AI attribution. The unmerged candidate tip is expected for this pre-promotion independent-review node and is not treated as a scope defect.
